services.name: kauai Beach Chair rentals
services.desc: Enhance your beach day experience with Hanalei Surf Co.'s premium Beach Chair and Umbrella rentals, made by Tommy Bahama! Nestled in the little town of Hanalei, Kauai, we offer comfortable and stylish beach chairs along with sturdy umbrellas to keep you cool and shaded under the Hawaiian sun. Our rentals are perfect for relaxing, reading a book, or simply enjoying the breathtaking ocean views. Make the most of your time on the sand with our convenient and affordable rentals, ensuring you have everything you need for a perfect day at the beach. Rentals based on a 24 hour period. $50 hold on a credit card required as a security

services.name: Surf Team
services.desc: Visiting the island for your dream Kauai surf vacation? We’ve got you covered with all the surf equipment you’ll need. We offer a wide range of surfboards to suit every skill level, from beginners to seasoned surfers. Our rental fleet includes longboards, shortboards, and everything in between, all maintained to the highest standards to ensure you have the best surfing experience possible. We cannot reserve specific boards. Boards are constantly being broken, repaired, and added. Our selection of 200+ boards allows you to find something that will work well for your skill

services.name: Reserve Snorkel gear
services.desc: Hanalei Surf Co. offers a huge selection of snorkel gear rentals on Kauai. Located on the North Shore, a short drive from Princeville, we are conveniently located on the way to the best snorkeling the Garden Island offers-the famous Tunnels Beach. We’re also close to Anini Beach which boasts the largest reef in Hawaii! Our friendly staff will set you up with high-quality snorkel equipment and recommend the safest and best places to snorkel on Kauai that day. Ocean conditions are always changing. Rentals based on a 24 hour period. $50 hold on a credit card required as a security
